newsitem.title: GERMANY: BASF - some signs of recovery in prices.
newsitem.headline: BASF - some signs of recovery in prices.

text.p: German chemicals and drugs group BASF AG said on Wednesday that it saw some signs that prices were recovering in parts of the industry.
"By now there are signs that prices, at least in some areas, are recovering," BASF management board chairman Juergen Strube told a news conference.
The German chemical industry has been suffering under particular price pressures during the year, which several large companies, including BASF, said had impacted on results.
